newsitem.title: USA: FedEx introduces new intl services.
newsitem.headline: FedEx introduces new intl services.

text.p: Federal Express said it will make its flat-rate FedEx Box available to North American shippers as part of a series of international enhancements that also includes lower priority rates from the United States to Canada.

The 25 kg and 10 kg boxes, already available for shipments to North America, will be made available for shipments from the U.S. and Canada - on June 9 and July 2 respectively - with 1-3 day time definite delivery to 211 countries.
FedEx also said effective July 1, it will offer FedEx International Economy service from the U.S. to major cities in 22 countries. Right now, Economy is available only between Canada and the U.S..
International Economy offers guaranteed delivery within five days for lower rates than faster FedEx products.

Also from July 1, FedEx said it will cut International Priority rates from the U.S. to major Canadian cities by up to 30 percent by introducing a two-tier pricing system: one for major cities in Canada, one for smaller cities and rural locations. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
